goal: Correct Impala work log slang meaning
body: Correction to prior NouGenMachine relay: Dave's phrase 'Uncle Mondy's bouzen' was not a family relation. In Haitian Creole slang, 'bouzen' means whore/prostitute. Keep the vehicle work attached to Uncle Mondy's context, but do not encode 'bouzen' as cousin.

This correction governs: bouzen is recorded as Kreyol slang, no kinship encoded; the 210833Z "cousin" reading is marked retracted inside the shard. Lug specs and ledger context kept; registration data not reproduced.
